name: player-commands
author: Ragnarok Offline
description: Gives every account @autoloot, @showexp and the rest of the information commands, instead of reserving them for GMs. Off until you turn it on.

settings.label: Also give everyone @go
settings.description: Free warping to the main towns, plus Eden and Para Market in renewal. Type @go on its own for the list.

settings.label: Also give everyone @warp
settings.description: Warp to any map by name, dungeons and fields included, e.g. @warp prt_fild08 170 200. Maps the server marks as no-warp stay closed.
